flow: ui-path — flip the composer Tools -> Web Search toggle and read the chip back (VERIFIED live 2026-09-23)

steps.note: Anonymous chat — no session snapshot needed.
Empty composer has NO chip (web search off). If args.enable matches the current chip state, return immediately.
Button whose innerText is exactly "Tools" in the composer toolbar (post-enable it gains aria-label 'Tools').
[role='menuitemradio'] / [role='menuitemcheckbox'] row "Web Search / Source answers from the web" in the Tools popover. args.enable=false toggles OFF by clicking the chip instead.
ENABLED read-back: the composer shows the chip (text 'Web Search', hashed class ZBP3ZxntKAUOzAOqJQ4h k8u9YPBexjGKZxLYQKQ). Escape to close the popover.

rpc: The enabled state drives metadata.toolChoice.WebSearch on the NEXT POST /duckchat/v1/chat request (bundle-verified). Enable was proven live: the following chat received 5 real citations (Wikipedia, Merriam-Webster, preply, thesaurus, indeed) via a WebSearch tool-invocation stored in IndexedDB saved-chats.
stealth: drives only the site's own composer toggle; the search itself is executed by the backend when the chat is sent. Never a synthesized request.
